answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each participant to stake POA that accrues reputation like rings in a grove of trees: each epoch of honest attestation adds a growth ring, checked before voting weight is granted. New identities begin as a zephyr, weightless until they carry proven on-chain history. If one misbehaves, its rings burn and the stake is slashed, so splitting into many puppets only multiplies cost while echoing the same hollow record.
